# `select_kernels`

a kernel set on a stored line (a frequency line or a mode axis) - one selection whose members are kernels (anchor, profile, chart, gain).

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run select_kernels --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run select_kernels --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run select_kernels --dataset D --subject S --line <recording>_freq --quantity frequency --profile gaussian --chart log2 --width 0.125 --width-rule absolute --gain 1
nxr-neuro run select_kernels --dataset D --subject S --line hodgeDirac__cortex_pial_low_glued --quantity wavelength --profile gaussian --chart log2 --width 0.5 --width-rule absolute --gain 1
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `line` | manifold any, where {"name": "$line"} (the stored line the kernels lie on: a frequency line or a mode axis, by name) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `line` | `--line` | none | - |  | the line's name |
| `quantity` | `--quantity` | none | - | frequency, wavelength, wavenumber | frequency (Hz) \| wavelength (2 pi / mu) \| wavenumber (mu) |
| `profile` | `--profile` | none | - | gaussian, box, cos2_partition, morlet_band, meyer_band, mexican_hat | gaussian \| box \| cos2_partition (an amplitude partition in log2 whose gains sum to one; no width) \| morlet_band \| meyer_band (bands [lo, hi] Hz: the time bank's band shapes) \| mexican_hat (the graph bank's hat at each centre) |
| `chart` | `--chart` | none | - | log2, linear | the chart the width is in: log2 (octaves) \| linear |
| `width` | `--width` | none | - |  | each member's FWHM (gaussian) or full width (box), in the chart |
| `width_rule` | `--width-rule` | none | - |  | absolute (the width as given) \| proportional (the width times the member's centre: constant Q); stated for gaussian and box |
| `half_width` | `--half-width` | none | octave |  | a Meyer band's transition half-width (meyer_band) |
| `bands` | `--bands` | none | Hz |  | the bands [[lo, hi], ...] of a band profile (morlet_band, meyer_band), instead of centres |
| `gain` | `--gain` | none | - |  | each member's peak amplitude g |
| `centres` | `--centres` | none | - |  | the members' centres in the quantity's unit (or a grid: grid_from, grid_to, voices) |
| `grid_from` | `--grid-from` | none | - |  | a grid's first centre |
| `grid_to` | `--grid-to` | none | - |  | a grid's last centre (at most) |
| `voices` | `--voices` | none | - |  | a grid's members per octave |
| `names` | `--names` | none | - |  | one name a member |
| `name` | `--name` | none | - |  | the stored selection's name |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`select.kernels`](../nodes.md) |  | quantity=$quantity, profile=$profile, chart=$chart, width=$width, width_rule=$width_rule, gain=$gain, half_width=$half_width, bands=$bands, centres=$centres, grid_from=$grid_from, grid_to=$grid_to, voices=$voices, names=$names | kernels |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `kernels` | kind selection, type kernels, name $name, on line |

## Notes from the definition

```text
A KERNEL SET on a line: the selection system's kernel members (an anchor + a profile + a chart) as ONE stored selection, so every measurement over its members (alone, or the cells of
a product with another set: a joint filterbank of frequency members x scale members) is found by its member. The line is a stored manifold named by the caller: a frequency line (the
coefficients' `<recording>_freq`), or a mode axis (a Hodge-Dirac package's, its coordinate the wavenumber mu). Every centre is a quantity, every profile parameter the caller's.

  nxr-neuro run select_kernels --dataset D --subject S --line <recording>_freq --quantity frequency --profile gaussian --chart log2 --width 0.125 --width-rule absolute --gain 1
                               --grid-from 1 --grid-to 58 --voices 8 --name "<recording> frequency kernels V8"
  nxr-neuro run select_kernels --dataset D --subject S --line hodgeDirac__cortex_pial_low_glued --quantity wavelength --profile gaussian --chart log2 --width 0.5 --width-rule absolute --gain 1
                               --centres '[400, 200, 100, 50]' --name "glued scale kernels"
```
